theorems.name: Submission.idtp_tpf_bss_dilation_image_slab
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (S : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (σ β : ℝ), 0 < σ → ∀ (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), (∀ y ∈ S, dist y x < σ → ‖(y - x) - Q.starProjection (y - x)‖ < β * σ) → ∀ u ∈ dilation x σ '' S, ‖u‖ < 1 → ‖u - Q.starProjection u‖ < β
